name: Negative test vectors for SD-JWT VC presentations under OpenID4VP 1.0 and HAIP 1.0
warning: TEST KEYS AND CERTIFICATES, derived from public seeds by make_vectors.py. Never trust them.

layers.control: the controls, which every verifier judges
layers.jose: JWS rules (RFC 7515, 7518, 8725) any JOSE verifier applies
layers.sd-jwt: RFC 9901, which any SD-JWT verifier applies
layers.sd-jwt-vc: the SD-JWT VC profile, which a verifier of SD-JWT VCs applies
layers.openid4vp: OpenID4VP 1.0, which a verifier receiving presentations over it applies
layers.haip-x509: the issuer's x5c chain under HAIP 1.0 and RFC 5280, which a verifier resolving keys from x5c applies
layers.x5c-issuer: the binding of iss to the x5c leaf that signed (SD-JWT VC s2.5), which a verifier resolving keys from x5c applies when it requires the leaf to name iss
layers.status-list: the Token Status List (draft-ietf-oauth-status-list), which a verifier checking status applies under the vector's policy

classes.control: a valid presentation: a correct verifier accepts it
classes.spec: a sentence of the cited text requires the refusal
classes.spec-implied: the cited sentence binds the issuer or the wallet, or a definition implies the refusal
classes.policy: no sentence requires the refusal: either the cited text says the verifier SHOULD refuse, and the verdict is the one the vector's policy reaches, or the text leaves the check to the verifier, and the verdict is that of a verifier that applies it (for x5c-issuer, one that requires the leaf to name iss)

policies.status-required: the relying party checks status: a credential that names a Token Status List is accepted only when the list its uri answers with is a Status List Token, signed by the key settings.status_list_keys states for the credential's iss and that uri, not expired, covering the index, and VALID (0) there

vectors.notes: The class of swiyu change dossier CD-008 (2026-07-31), whose shape differs: there the signing key was a DID named by kid, checked against iss; here it is an x5c leaf. polaris-oid4vp refuses it (issuer_key) when the issuer key comes from x5c, where it binds iss to the leaf. Its --issuer-jwks mode is documented not to bind iss to a key (its README: "list one issuer's keys per verifier"), so this family targets x5c-bound verification.
